en: Vintage black-and-white postcard with two inset photographs. The left image shows a hillside village with several houses in the foreground and, above them on the hill, a large pilgrimage church with twin towers. The right image shows a forest scene with an outdoor roadside crucifix (a wooden cross with a roofed shelter) and fencing around it. The captions beneath the images read "Maria-Trost bei Graz" under the left view and "Waldandacht" under the right, with a small printed serial number at the bottom left.
